# Miscellaneous

This page is for things that don’t quite fit into “formal research” but are still part of what I care about and what I’m experimenting with.

---

## /now

Right now, I’m:

- Wrapping up projects on **mutual intelligibility benchmarks** and **visual reasoning**.
- Cleaning up codebases so they are easier to reproduce and open-source.
- Slowly rebuilding my personal website and trying to write more consistently.

---

## Non-ML interests

A non-exhaustive list of things I like thinking about or doing when I’m not debugging training loops:

- **Fitness & health** – trying to get leaner and keep a sustainable routine around home workouts and cardio.
- **Day trading & markets** – learning how markets work, experimenting with small positions, and figuring out how to not be stupid with money.
- **Tooling & workflows** – shells, dotfiles, terminals, and anything that makes working on code less painful.

---

## Small experiments

Occasionally I run small side experiments that may or may not go anywhere:

- Playing with **agentic systems** that combine tools, memory, and “mood” for more persistent AI characters.
- Building **personal finance / expense tracking tools** (e.g., parsing mobile money SMS for automatic budgeting).
- Sketching ideas for **Amharic-first LLMs**, starting from data collection and evaluation strategies.

If any of these resonate with you, feel free to reach out — I’m always open to collaborating on interesting side projects.
